treasury.description: Review custody balances for the selected project, provider strategies for its environment, and organization-wide custodial positions.
treasury.summaryApyCaption: Value-weighted live rate across open positions
treasury.summaryApyUnavailable: Unavailable until every open position has a live value and rate
treasury.summaryCashUnavailable: A wallet balance could not be read
treasury.summaryDeployedUnavailable: A position value could not be read
treasury.summaryDeployedUnreconciled: A wallet holds vault shares with no matching position
treasury.summaryEmptyFloat: No stablecoin balances to allocate yet
treasury.walletDescription: Active wallets and token balances read from the selected project.
treasury.walletsError: Wallets could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
treasury.walletsEmptyDescription: Create a wallet before depositing into a provider strategy.
treasury.vaultPositionsDescription: Every open vault position recorded for the selected project, hydrated from chain when the provider is available.
treasury.vaultPositionsErrorDescription: Live vault holdings could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
treasury.vaultPositionsIncompleteDescription: A custody wallet holds vault shares this list has no record of, so it cannot be shown as empty. Refresh to try again.
treasury.vaultPositionsEmptyDescription: A position appears here after a provider confirms a vault deposit.
treasury.positionStatusDescription: The latest deposit or withdrawal state for this position. It updates automatically while Solana settles the transaction.
treasury.positionStatusActiveDescription: No deposit or withdrawal is currently in flight for this position.
treasury.depositStatusPendingDescription: SDP is checking the transaction because its current network state is not yet known.
treasury.depositStatusSubmittedDescription: The deposit was sent to Solana and is waiting for confirmation.
treasury.depositStatusConfirmedDescription: The latest deposit is confirmed on-chain.
treasury.depositStatusFailedDescription: The latest deposit failed and did not add funds to this position.
treasury.withdrawalStatusRequestedDescription: The withdrawal is recorded and waiting for safe broadcast.
treasury.withdrawalStatusSubmittedDescription: The withdrawal was sent to Solana and is waiting for confirmation.
treasury.withdrawalStatusConfirmedDescription: Solana confirmed the withdrawal. SDP is waiting for final settlement.
treasury.withdrawalStatusFinalizedDescription: The withdrawal is final and the proceeds are in the custody wallet.
treasury.withdrawalStatusFailedDescription: The withdrawal failed. Shares that were not redeemed remain in the position.
treasury.strategiesDescription: Provider-synced opportunities and live vault holdings for this environment.
treasury.strategiesErrorDescription: Strategies or live vault positions could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
treasury.strategiesEmptyDescription: The provider catalogue has no surfaced strategies for this environment.
treasury.rateDisclosure: Rates are provider-reported and variable. Position values are read live from chain; unavailable reads are never shown as zero.
treasury.accessDisclosure: Provider access could not be verified, so deposit actions remain disabled.
treasury.productionDisclosure: New vault deposits are intentionally closed in production until the Active tab surfaces vault positions there. Withdrawals stay available wherever a position exists. Switch to Sandbox to build and test the deposit flow.
treasury.existingProgramsDescription: Organization-wide custodial programs for this environment remain visible and withdrawable even when their provider is no longer offered for new deposits.
treasury.existingProgramsUnavailable: Existing custodial positions could not be loaded from the provider.
treasury.withdrawalApprovalUnavailable: A provider may mark a withdrawal Awaiting approval. SDP cannot action that approval yet; an authorized provider approver must complete it outside this dashboard, and you should not resubmit it.

earnProgram.dashboardDescription: See every end-user position in this project, grouped into a complete live view. Values refresh from the provider and are never estimated.
earnProgram.walletRefreshError: Wallet details could not be refreshed. The strategy total remains visible.
earnProgram.portfolioDescription: Live value across your customers, grouped by strategy and deposit token.
earnProgram.portfolioErrorDescription: The complete live portfolio could not be loaded. No balances are shown until every page is confirmed.
earnProgram.portfolioRefreshError: The latest refresh failed. Showing the last complete portfolio while we retry automatically.
earnProgram.incompletePortfolio: Live values are unavailable for {count} position(s). Affected totals are withheld rather than shown as zero or partial.
earnProgram.introTitle: Choose a yield strategy to integrate
earnProgram.introDescription: Choose from the live strategy catalogue, then follow a server-side guide for customer deposits, portfolio reads, and withdrawals.
earnProgram.selectDescription: Only strategies the selected environment can fund are selectable.
earnProgram.mainnetCatalogueDescription: Preview Mainnet strategies for integration planning. This Sandbox project cannot fund them.
earnProgram.mainnetPreviewDescription: This vault runs on Mainnet. You can review the integration guide here, but a Production project is required to submit deposits.
earnProgram.selectionSummary: {strategy} selected. Continue when you are ready.
earnProgram.rateDisclosure: APYs come from the provider and can change. The API applies wallet scope, provider eligibility, and policy checks again when a deposit is submitted.
earnProgram.accessDisclosure: Provider access could not be verified, so strategy selection remains disabled.
earnProgram.productionDisclosure: New vault deposits are intentionally closed in production until vault positions are surfaced on the Active tab. Withdrawals stay available wherever a position exists. Switch to Sandbox to build and test the deposit flow.
earnProgram.catalogueErrorDescription: Live provider strategies could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
earnProgram.catalogueEmptyDescription: No provider strategies are surfaced for this environment.
earnProgram.integrateDescription: Copy the complete server flow for strategy discovery, customer-signed deposits, live portfolio reads, and withdrawals. The wallet signs client-side; your API key never leaves your server.
earnProgram.guideClientTitle: 1 · Set up SDP and the wallet boundary
earnProgram.guideClientDescription: Create a project-scoped server client, discover strategies, and pass only unsigned transaction bytes to the customer's wallet.
earnProgram.guideDepositDescription: Build, sign, submit, then poll. Reuse the same idempotency key for safe retries.
earnProgram.guidePortfolioDescription: Read balances, exact earnings, activity, and withdrawable positions from the live portfolio.
earnProgram.guideWithdrawDescription: Build and submit exits with the same customer-signing and idempotency model.
earnProgram.secretKeyDisclosure: Keep SDP_API_KEY on your server, never in the client.
earnProgram.missingStrategyDescription: Return to Embedded Yield and select a live strategy this integration should fund.
earnProgram.unknownStrategyDescription: The selected strategy is no longer in the live catalogue for this project. Return to Embedded Yield and choose another strategy.
earnProgram.unavailableStrategyDescription: This strategy is inactive, unsupported for Embedded Yield buttons, or unavailable on the selected project's cluster.
earnProgram.unavailableEnvironmentDescription: New Embedded Yield vault deposits are sandbox-only until vault positions are surfaced in the production portfolio.
earnProgram.unavailableAccessDescription: Provider access could not be verified for this organization, so the strategy cannot be configured safely.
earnProgram.unavailableProviderDescription: This provider is not enabled for the selected organization and project environment.

dvp.description: Atomic trades: both legs move together or neither does. Publish an escrow address, the counterparty sends an ordinary transfer, and settlement delivers each side at once.
dvp.landingDescription: Trade an issued asset against cash with no counterparty risk. Neither side can take the other's leg without giving up its own.
dvp.emptyDescription: Create one here, or through the API.
dvp.escrowHint: Send exactly the target amount here as an ordinary token transfer. Nothing else is needed to fund a leg.
dvp.notObservedHint: Nothing has read this escrow since the trade was created, so its balance is unknown rather than zero.
dvp.surplusTitle: Holds more than the trade needs
dvp.surplusDescription: Settlement refunds the surplus to whoever sent it. On a mint with a transfer hook that refund can fail, and a failed refund reverts the whole settlement. Anyone can send tokens to an escrow, so this is worth checking before settling.
dvp.frozenDescription: Transfers into this escrow will bounce until the mint's freeze authority thaws it. A zero balance here does not mean nobody has paid.
dvp.observedHint: The program emits no events, so every status is a reading taken at a moment in time rather than a notification.
dvp.settleBlocked: Both legs must be funded before a trade can settle.
dvp.cancelHint: Refunds each leg to whoever deposited it and closes the trade. Cannot be undone.
dvp.settleHint: Delivers each leg to the other party and closes the trade. Cannot be undone.
dvp.approvalPendingDescription: Your organization's wallet policy requires this action to be approved. It appears in Approvals.
dvp.settlementAuthorityHint: A wallet this project owns, created on its first trade. It holds the only key that can settle or cancel, and it pays the network fee and the account rent for doing so, so it needs a small SOL balance.

statusHint.creating: Signed and recorded, but it has not been seen on chain yet.
statusHint.create_failed: The create transaction can no longer land. Nothing was created.
statusHint.closed_unknown: The trade account is gone. Settle, cancel and reject all close it and none of them announce which, so the outcome is not known from the account alone.

dvp.loadErrorTitle: This trade could not be loaded
dvp.loadErrorDescription: The trade may still exist. The request to read it did not succeed, so reload to try again.
dvp.fundHint: Moves this leg from its custody wallet into the escrow. Once there, only settling, cancelling or reclaiming gets it back.
dvp.createDescription: Both legs settle together or neither does. You publish an escrow address for each leg, and the counterparty funds theirs with an ordinary transfer.
dvp.fieldWalletHint: Holds your side of the trade, pays the fees, and pays rent for the escrows.
dvp.fieldCounterpartyHint: Any Solana address. They sign nothing here and need no account with us.
dvp.fieldAssetMintHint: One of your issued tokens. If its mint carries an extension DvP refuses, creating the trade tells you which one.
dvp.fieldAmountHint: Base units, as a whole number. Not a decimal amount.
dvp.fieldExpiryHint: After this the trade can no longer settle. Must be within a year.
dvp.fieldRefHint: Optional. Ties this trade to your own records, and both sides can read it on chain. Anyone can copy the same value onto their own trade, so treat it as a label and never as proof.
dvp.createEmptyTokens: No deployed tokens in this project yet. Paste a mint address instead.
dvp.fieldCashMintHint: What the other side pays with.
dvp.fieldAmountHintDecimals: As you would write it. {symbol} has {decimals} decimals.
dvp.fieldAmountHintRaw: Base units, as a whole number. Decimals are unknown for a pasted mint, so this is not a decimal amount.
dvp.summaryIncomplete: Fill in both legs and a counterparty to see the trade.
dvp.groupYourSideHint: Which of your wallets holds the leg you are delivering, and which leg that is.
dvp.groupLegsHint: What each side puts up. Amounts are entered the way you would write them, and converted for you.
dvp.groupTermsHint: Who you are trading with, and how long they have to fund.
dvp.fieldWalletHintWithAddress: {address}. Holds your side of the trade, pays the fees, and pays rent for the escrows.
dvp.fieldCounterpartyInvalid: That does not look like a Solana address. They are 32 to 44 base58 characters.
dvp.sideAssetDetail: You fund the {deliver} leg. They fund {receive}.
dvp.sideCashDetail: You fund the {deliver} leg. They fund {receive}.
dvp.stepEscrows: Creating the trade publishes one escrow address per leg.
dvp.stepFund: You fund your leg from your wallet; {counterparty} sends an ordinary transfer to theirs.
dvp.stepSettle: Once both legs are funded, settling delivers each side at once.
dvp.wrongClusterWarning: The DvP program is deployed on devnet only. This project is on {cluster}, so creating a trade will be refused.
dvp.nextCreatingTitle: Waiting for the create to land
dvp.nextCreatingBody: The transaction is signed and recorded but has not been seen on chain yet. Nothing is owed by either side until it lands.
dvp.nextFundYoursTitle: Your leg is not funded yet
dvp.nextFundYoursBothBody: Fund your leg below. The counterparty funds theirs by sending an ordinary transfer to their escrow address; neither of you can take the other side without giving up your own.
dvp.nextFundYoursOnlyBody: The counterparty has already funded. Fund your leg below and the trade is ready to settle.
dvp.nextAwaitThemBody: Your leg is funded. Send them their escrow address; once their transfer lands, this trade can settle.
dvp.nextSettleBody: Both legs hold their target. Settling delivers each side to the other at once and closes the trade. It cannot be undone.
dvp.nextExpiredBody: This trade can no longer settle. Cancelling refunds each leg to whoever deposited it and closes the trade.
dvp.nextCreateFailedBody: The create transaction can no longer land, so nothing was put on chain and nothing is at risk. Create a new trade to try again.
dvp.loadErrorUnexpected: The request succeeded but carried no trade.
dvp.amountExceedsBalance: More than this wallet holds today. The trade will still be created; funding your leg is what would fail.
dvp.fieldRefTooLong: Too long by {over} bytes. Accents and emoji cost more than one byte each.
dvp.onChainAddressHint: The trade itself, as an account on Solana. It holds the terms and both escrows, and closes when the trade does. A counterparty can look it up to check the trade is real before paying anything.
dvp.legFrozen: Escrow frozen, transfers in will bounce
dvp.legOverFunded: Holds more than the trade needs
dvp.toastCreated: Trade created. Escrow addresses are published below.
dvp.sdpWalletHint: Your custody wallet — the one this trade spends from and delivers to.
dvp.fieldCounterpartyIsOwnWallet: This is the wallet funding your own leg. A trade needs two parties, so pick a different address — another of your wallets is fine.
dvp.counterpartyHint: The other side of this trade. They sign nothing here and hold no account with us.
dvp.authorityUnfundedBody: Settling pays the network fee and the rent for the token accounts it has to create, and this project's settlement authority cannot cover that yet. Send at least {sol} SOL to {address}, then settle.
dvp.cancelConfirmBody: Each leg goes back to whoever deposited it and the trade closes for good. Neither side can settle it afterwards, and creating it again means a new trade with new escrow addresses.

overview.programDescription: What you have earning right now. Each one is funded and withdrawn on its own, and every balance is read live.
overview.holdingsEmpty: No deposits detected yet. Funds land as cash, then deploy toward the strategy on the provider's later rebalances.
overview.activityRebalanceComplete: Rebalance complete — your program is back on target
overview.activityFailed: The provider reports a problem with your program. Check the status before retrying.
overview.withdrawalCompleted: Withdrawal complete — funds have settled to your address
overview.withdrawalPartiallyCompleted: Withdrawal only partly settled. Check the amount paid before retrying.
overview.withdrawalFailed: Withdrawal failed — no funds left your program. Check the reason before retrying.
overview.withdrawalCancelled: Withdrawal cancelled — no funds left your program.
overview.withdrawalPendingApproval: Withdrawal is waiting on an approval signature.
overview.programLoadError: The Embedded Yield workspace could not be loaded.
overview.providerNotConfigured: Live Embedded Yield data is unavailable in this environment — the provider API key is not configured yet.
overview.catalogueLoadError: The strategy catalogue could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
overview.catalogueEmpty: No strategies are available in this environment yet.
overview.rateDisclosure: APY figures are variable and shown for comparison only. Actual rates and redemption times are set by the provider.
overview.depositAddressLabel: Deposit — send USDC on Solana to
overview.cashDeploys: Deploys toward the strategy on a later rebalance — small amounts may stay as cash

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Funds leave the shared portfolio and settle to a Solana address you control.
withdraw.availableUnavailable: Couldn't check the available balance. You can still withdraw — the provider confirms the amount when you submit.
withdraw.createdDescription: The withdrawal is processing. Funds settle to the destination address once the provider completes it.
withdraw.pendingApprovalDescription: An authorized provider approver must complete this outside SDP. This dashboard cannot action the approval yet; do not resubmit the withdrawal.
withdraw.providerUnavailable: SDP does not expose a Solana withdrawal lane for this provider, so this action is disabled.
withdraw.errorAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
withdraw.errorExceedsCeiling: More than the {amount} available as {token} right now.
withdraw.previewInsufficient: The provider can't fill this {token} withdrawal — the withdrawable balance may sit in the other stablecoin. Try a smaller amount or switch stablecoin.
withdraw.previewInsufficientCeiling: The provider can pay {amount} as {token} right now. Enter that or less.
withdraw.previewNoSolanaPayout: {token} doesn't pay out on Solana — the provider settles {token} withdrawals on Ethereum only. Withdraw USDC instead.

playground.amountOptional: Optional. Omit to ask what this lane can pay right now.
playground.requestIdRequired: Required UUIDv4 idempotency key — a retry must reuse it.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: Ways to put idle stablecoins to work. Compare what each one pays, how it's backed, and how fast you can withdraw — rank by pool size or APY.

deposit.walletTitle: Choose the wallet that funds this program
deposit.walletDescription: Deposits are sent from this wallet, and withdrawals come back to it.
deposit.walletCustodyTitle: You keep custody until you deposit
deposit.walletCustodyBody: The program gets its own provider-managed Solana deposit address. Nothing moves until you send stablecoins to it.
deposit.walletsLoadError: Your wallets could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
deposit.walletsEmptyBody: Create one in the Wallets module first — the deposit flow needs a wallet to send from.
deposit.connectFireblocksBody: Provision an institutional wallet on Fireblocks, then start this deposit again.
deposit.strategyDescription: Compare the available strategies by backing, access, pool size, and APY.
deposit.strategiesEmpty: No strategies are available in this environment yet.
deposit.strategiesLoadError: The strategy catalogue could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
deposit.strategyEnvironmentUnavailable: This strategy is hosted on {environment} and cannot be deposited into from this project.
deposit.strategyProviderUnavailable: This provider is available for catalogue browsing but does not support this deposit flow yet.
deposit.strategyAssetUnavailable: This strategy does not use a stablecoin supported by this deposit flow.
deposit.strategyAvailabilityDisclosure: Strategies that cannot be funded from this project remain visible for comparison.
deposit.reviewDescription: Nothing has moved yet. Confirming sets the program's strategy.
deposit.routingBody: Every {token} deposit routes fully into this strategy. Deposits in other stablecoins keep whatever allocation they have today.
deposit.createBody: Confirming provisions one provider-managed wallet for your organization in this environment and sets its strategy.
deposit.updateBody: Your program already exists. Confirming replaces the {token} target immediately; existing balances move toward it on the provider's later rebalances.
deposit.rateDisclosure: APY is variable and shown for comparison only. Actual rates and redemption times are set by the provider.
deposit.integrationTitle: Drive this program from your API
deposit.integrationDescription: Your organization has API keys, so everything you just did is available programmatically. These are live endpoints.
deposit.integrationAuthNote: Authenticate with your secret key as a bearer token. Secrets are never shown here — only the prefix you created.
deposit.liveDescription: Send stablecoins on Solana to the address below. Funds arrive as cash, then deploy toward {strategy} on the provider's later rebalances.
deposit.depositAddressBody: Send {token} on Solana to this address. Deposits are detected automatically.
deposit.walletCreatingBody: This usually takes under a minute. The deposit address appears here as soon as it is ready.
deposit.walletFailed: The program wallet reports a problem. Try again shortly, or contact support if it persists.
deposit.depositsEmpty: No deposits yet. Transfers appear here shortly after they land on-chain.
deposit.depositsLoadError: Deposits could not be loaded. They refresh automatically.
deposit.connectFireblocksLockedBody: Fireblocks needs to be activated for your organization before you can provision a wallet on it.
deposit.timingDisclosure: Confirming saves the target immediately, but money moves on the provider's later rebalances — not instantly. Slower strategies can take hours to converge, and small balances may stay as cash where deploying them isn't economical.
deposit.programMissing: That strategy could not be found — it may have been changed or removed since this link was made. Head back to Embedded Yield to see your current strategies.
deposit.creationUnavailable: Embedded Yield strategies are open for comparison only right now — no provider is accepting deposits, so there is no strategy to set up. Head back to Embedded Yield to browse what is listed.
deposit.vaultWalletBody: Choose a wallet and amount. The wallet signs the transaction and receives the vault shares.
deposit.vaultSwapNotice: Your {source} is swapped to {target} through Jupiter inside the same transaction, so the swap and the deposit land together or not at all. The deposit is sized to the swap's guaranteed minimum ({pct}% tolerance); anything better stays in your wallet as {target}.
deposit.vaultBalanceUnknown: Balance unavailable right now — the network remains the authority.
deposit.vaultAmountPrecision: Enter an amount with no more than {decimals} decimal places.
deposit.vaultOverBalance: That exceeds this wallet's last observed balance. You can still submit because the network makes the final decision.
deposit.vaultConfirmNote: Your wallet pays the network fee.
deposit.vaultQuoteUnavailable: The live share quote is unavailable right now, so this deposit cannot be sized safely. Try again in a moment.
deposit.vaultQuoteBlocked: The vault is not accepting this deposit right now: {message}
deposit.vaultQuoteZeroShares: This amount is too small to mint any shares at the current rate, so there is no slippage floor that could protect it. Increase the amount.
deposit.vaultSlippageHelp: The deposit refuses to execute if the vault would mint fewer shares than this tolerance allows. 10 basis points is 0.1%.
deposit.vaultSlippageInvalid: Enter a whole number of basis points from 1 to {max}.
deposit.vaultSlippageExceeded: The vault would return fewer shares than your slippage tolerance allows for this amount. Increase the tolerance below and try again.
deposit.vaultSubmitError: The vault deposit could not be submitted.
deposit.vaultDoneBody: Signed and sent to Solana. Confirmation can take a moment.
deposit.vaultSettlingNote: Your position appears after confirmation and the provider's next chain read.
deposit.vaultConfirmedNote: The live position will reflect the provider's next successful chain read.
deposit.vaultPendingBody: SDP signed the deposit but could not establish its final network state. Do not retry with a new idempotency key; inspect the transaction first.
deposit.vaultApprovalBody: Your wallet policy accepted the request for review. No vault deposit has been submitted yet.
deposit.vaultAbsorbedTitle: Deposit already completed by your approval
deposit.vaultAbsorbedBody: Your earlier approval for this exact deposit executed just before this submission, so the request was absorbed as a retry of it. Funds moved once, through the approval — this submission moved nothing additional.
deposit.vaultAbsorbedNote: The details below are the approved deposit. If you intended a second deposit of the same amount, submit again.
deposit.vaultHeldKeyUnavailable: SDP could not check whether your earlier approved deposit already went through, so nothing was submitted. Try again in a moment.

vaultWithdraw.title: Withdraw from {position}
vaultWithdraw.body: Redeem shares to {token} in the same custody wallet.
vaultWithdraw.sharesUnknown: Share balance unavailable right now — the network remains the authority.
vaultWithdraw.sharesAvailable: {available} withdrawable of {total} total. Unstake the remainder in Kamino first.
vaultWithdraw.withdrawableUnknown: {shares} total shares observed, but the withdrawable balance is unavailable. Max is disabled.
vaultWithdraw.sharesInvalid: Enter a share amount greater than zero.
vaultWithdraw.overShares: That exceeds this position's last observed withdrawable share balance. You can still submit because the network is the authority, but the withdrawal will fail on-chain if the balance is insufficient.
vaultWithdraw.confirmNote: The custody wallet signs and pays the network fee.
vaultWithdraw.confirmNoteSponsored: The custody wallet signs. SDP covers the network fee.
vaultWithdraw.quoteUnavailable: The live payout quote is unavailable right now, so this withdrawal cannot be sized safely. Try again in a moment.
vaultWithdraw.quoteBlocked: The vault is not paying out this withdrawal right now: {message}
vaultWithdraw.quoteZeroAssets: These shares are too few to redeem any of the deposit token at the current rate, so there is no slippage floor that could protect the exit.
vaultWithdraw.slippageHelp: The withdrawal refuses to execute if the vault would pay less than this tolerance allows. 10 basis points is 0.1%.
vaultWithdraw.slippageExceeded: The vault would pay less than your slippage tolerance allows for these shares. Increase the tolerance below and try again.
vaultWithdraw.submitError: The vault withdrawal could not be submitted.
vaultWithdraw.heldKeyUnavailable: A previous submission of this exact withdrawal is pending approval, and its status could not be checked. Try again once the connection recovers.
vaultWithdraw.approvalBody: Your organization's wallet policy requires approval for this withdrawal. Nothing has been signed; the exit executes once an approver acts.
vaultWithdraw.absorbedBody: An earlier approval of this exact withdrawal has already executed. This submission moved nothing; the transaction below is the approval's.
vaultWithdraw.absorbedNote: If you intended a second withdrawal, submit it again as a new request.
vaultWithdraw.recordedBody: Signed and recorded. SDP will keep retrying the broadcast safely.
vaultWithdraw.recordedNote: Status continues updating in Active positions after you close this.
vaultWithdraw.submittedBody: Signed and sent to Solana. Finalization can take a moment.
vaultWithdraw.confirmedBody: Confirmed on Solana and waiting for final settlement.
vaultWithdraw.finalizedBody: The withdrawal is final and the proceeds are in the custody wallet.
vaultWithdraw.finalizedNote: Position and wallet balances have been refreshed.
vaultWithdraw.settlingNote: Status continues updating in Active positions after you close this.
